answer: A random beacon plus heartbeat stops fake identities. Each epoch the beacon picks random agents, who must answer a heartbeat and show the thread of their jobs; a fake shows nothing. Each identity posts 150 POA thawing as slowly as a glacier, a twentieth per epoch, early exit forfeits most. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 150 = 15,000 POA plus a machine each; one honest agent pays one bond, keeps trading, passing with compute it already runs.
